title: Reuse daemon packaging entry point
implementation: Added root package:daemon alias resolving the existing node scripts/release-assets.mjs daemon implementation (platform linux|mac, VERSION, BINARY, DEST, optional --dev LABEL). No new packager, no release performed, root package version untouched (0.2.7 stays). Donor scripts/release-assets.test.mjs hunk (OMP runtime bundling assertions) belongs to the OMP boundary tasks and was not imported. Existing release-assets tests stay unchanged; the alias is proven by a throwaway actual npm run package:daemon fixture smoke (release and --dev forms, real tar archive inspection), removed after proof — no permanent wiring/source-copy test. Additive CLI alias only: existing direct script invocations and CI are unchanged; documented in docs/operations/releasing.md and CHANGELOG.md. No new ADR (entry-point alias within existing release ownership).
acceptance: Script resolves the existing daemon implementation and archive expectations; focused release-assets checks pass without releasing artifacts. Verified by actual npm run package:daemon invocations against fixture binaries with real tar archive inspection (throwaway smoke), plus the unchanged existing release-assets suite.

required: affected fmt/clippy/build/tests and runtime smoke for changed backend
affected SDK/UI/protocol checks and documented old-host/client downgrade
results: throwaway actual smoke: npm run package:daemon -- linux 0.0.7 <fixture> <dest> → exit 0, 'Ait-0.0.7-daemon-linux-x64.tar.gz'; tar -tvzf → aitd -rwxr-xr-x + LICENSE

throwaway actual smoke: npm run package:daemon -- mac 0.0.7 <dev fixture> <dest> --dev abcdef01-2026-10-08 → exit 0, 'Ait-abcdef01-2026-10-08-daemon-macos-arm64.tar.gz'; tar -tvzf → aitd -rwxr-xr-x + LICENSE; fixtures/archives removed after proof
